note: Registered lab artifacts that make up the tester release. File sources are relative to the workspace root (BC250_ROOT), licence sources to the repository. build-release.ps1 refuses a source whose SHA256 differs. The AMD firmware is not packaged: the installer downloads it at the pinned commit.

mft_h264.note: The H.264 encoder Media Foundation transform (M15.11). register true: the installer copies payload/mft/amdgpu_wddm_mft_h264.dll to <install root>\mft\ and writes route A of driver/umd/mft-h264/INSTALL.md machine wide. register false: the installer installs and registers nothing, and takes away what an earlier install of this release family wrote. The value travels into manifest.json, so the package itself says what it does. This is the bisect lever of the encoder wagon.

public_commits.note: Built commit -> commit on a public branch, for every pair that differs. Every commit this release was built from is published at its own hash. D-Ogi/amdgpu-wddm holds 85ac47b6 on branch train/b19-setup. That commit is the b19 integration merge, and it built the kernel driver and the two D3D11 shells. The same branch holds 3ef45a0f, which built the control application 0.5.1.0, the control DLL and the CLI, and 62aa9bc0, which built the D3D12 shell. 62aa9bc0 is 85ac47b6 with the knob-channel fix of the entry path on top, and no other file of this release comes from it. Every wagon commit is an ancestor of all three. From bc250-win: main d5593267, kmd208-loglines 099aaf0b, m14/d3d11-nv12-planes f3ff6ca5, train/b19-d3d12-shell 46c9a479 and bd075/d3d12-shared-fail-fast 2d91b983. Also train/b19-wow64-x86 a748e78e, train/b19-desktop-umd 2509d282, bd069-gui-closed-record 9324a353, bd069-repair-closures 7ca41cc2 and gui/p1-setup 8279a9d9. D-Ogi/mesa-amdgpu-wddm holds 31844893 on amdgpu-wddm/b19-icd, 76ab2c27 on amdgpu-wddm/b19-desktop-umd and 7117b189 on amdgpu-wddm/b19-hosted-umd. D-Ogi/dxvk, D-Ogi/vkd3d-proton and D-Ogi/dxil-spirv keep branch amdgpu-wddm/upstream-2026-10-05. The system Vulkan ICD is the build of 2732f9c8, which the fork publishes on branch amdgpu-wddm/gdi-immediate-quiet (597fc6e2), as in 0.7.205.100-tester.11. The hosted ICD of the desktop route is the build of 48546c73. No file of this release needs a patch on top of its commit. The x86 patches of the earlier releases are gone (BD-064). The pair note of 0.7.207.100-tester.12 about ae98c795 and 091ad563 therefore no longer applies. Both b19 RADV files report git-3184489333 as their Mesa version, which is 31844893. Under driver, tools/build and third_party the two commits differ in two files only. They are driver/umd/d3d12/engine-ddi/entry.cpp and engine-ddi.h, which the D3D12 shell alone compiles. The other binaries of 85ac47b6 are therefore the binaries of 62aa9bc0. Three files come from the build of the wagon train/b19-wow64-x86 a748e78e, not from a build of 85ac47b6. They are payload/desktop/bc250d3d_router.dll, payload/wow64/desktop/bc250d3d_router.dll and payload/syswow64/bc250umd.dll. The router and stub sources are the same at both commits. Their recipes have no /Brepro, so a build gives a new hash for the same code. For the two routers tools/build/pe_compare.py compared a build from 85ac47b6 with the shipped file. The difference is the COFF time stamp, three debug-directory time stamps and the CodeView identifier. With those fields copied over, the hash is the shipped one again. The kernel driver of this release comes from bc250-win 002a83eb on branch train/b20-setup, the b20 integration, and not from 85ac47b6. That commit is not published yet. Push it to D-Ogi/amdgpu-wddm before this release goes to a tester.

files.role: KMD 0.7.212.1 INF (bc250-win 002a83eb, train/b20-setup). It adds the two Parameters values of the fan reader, both 0. The release re-stamps DriverVer and adds the Reboot directive

KMD 0.7.212.1, escape ABI 0x000700D4 (bc250-win 002a83eb, train/b20-setup: main 42b85d25 with the five b20 kernel wagons). The kernel is built with /Brepro and a sorted object list, and two builds gave the same unsigned bytes. Five changes against 0.7.208.1, and each new behaviour is off until a Parameters value turns it on. The driver can hand its own swap-chain buffers to the scan-out hardware (route C, EnableDirectFlipHandshake). It can read the fan speed, the fan duty and its own temperatures from the Super I/O chip (EnableHwmon). It can pair the notification of a finished packet with the report pass itself (NotifyDpcInReport), and it keeps a histogram of the gap between the ring and the vertical blank. The operator can give the automatic clock a voltage curve of their own, and can set a clock limit, an undervolt and a temperature cap for the processor, each one as a trial that falls back by itself. Re-signed with the release certificate, code unchanged
UMD stub, D3D9 slot of UserModeDriverName (driver/umd-stub)

D3D12 shell (bc250-win 62aa9bc0, train/b19-setup). Heap import retries the ownership unlock (BD-045). ClearRootArguments records the real values (BD-046). The direct recording entry of engine-ddi is the default (M15.9). The shell records each start of an application for the Recent page of the control application. A shared resource that the driver cannot make is refused with E_OUTOFMEMORY, and the device stays alive (BD-075). The entry path reads a knob file only when BC250_ENTRY_CFG names one. It writes its rows where BC250_ENTRY_LOG or %TEMP% puts them. There is no machine-wide file and no shared log directory, as in the ICD. Built with /Brepro, and byte identical over two builds

D3D12 engine (vkd3d-proton fork amdgpu-wddm/upstream-2026-10-05 4e9a98e9: 16 upstream commits merged into the b17 compile limiter 220099f5, submodule dxil-spirv d2d82332 = 14 upstream commits merged into bc773cf2)

D3D12 ICD (mesa fork amdgpu-wddm/b19-icd 31844893 on upstream-2026-10-05). The shader cache key covers the whole shader state again (BD-068). Handle types and host imports follow the contract (BD-038, BD-039). A buffer object takes the CPU lock for a mapped import (BD-045). Host policy version 2 reads no machine-wide file and writes no shared log. The disk cache stays one file. The file reports git-3184489333 as its Mesa version

desktop and application router (bc250-win train/b19-wow64-x86 a748e78e, driver/umd/router): gpu-default keeps Windows components and unresolved images on the CPU UMD. The router sources of 85ac47b6 are the same, and the recipe has no /Brepro, so the build of the wagon is kept. tools/build/pe_compare.py shows that a build from 85ac47b6 differs from this file in the COFF time stamp, three debug-directory time stamps and the CodeView identifier only

hosted zink D3D11 UMD for DWM on the GPU (mesa fork amdgpu-wddm/b19-hosted-umd 7117b189). The surface setup resumes after a failed step instead of leaking it (BD-037). The composed-surface table accepts one-byte pixels (A8)
hosted ICD for zink

CPU D3D11 UMD (mesa fork amdgpu-wddm/b19-desktop-umd 76ab2c27). The surface setup resumes after a failed step instead of leaking it (BD-037). The composed-surface table accepts one-byte pixels (A8). This is the fallback route for the D3D11 applications that the router does not send to the GPU

GPU D3D11 shell (bc250-win 85ac47b6, train/b19-merge). The shell accepts NV12 planes as encoder input (BD-071). The DDI error-status audit replaced 99 illegal report sites, and the gate tools/quality/ddi_error_policy.py holds the policy with 37 rows and 8 mutants. Built with /Brepro against DXVK fork 5611118e

GPU D3D11 caps record for engine C242BA6A and ICD 822134D0 (tools/build/write-umd-config.py). The shell refuses an engine or an ICD whose SHA-256 differs from this record. Capabilities carried from fl12caps001: FL 12_1, tiled resources tier 3, rasterizer ordered views, conservative rasterization tier 3

GPU D3D11 engine (DXVK fork amdgpu-wddm/upstream-2026-10-05 5611118e: 14 upstream commits merged into the b17 inline-throttle engine ebeadc49, the throttle wait moved to the new upstream wait site, plus the signal-tracker deduplication fix; submodule dxbc-spirv stays at f241996e)
GPU D3D11 ICD (mesa fork amdgpu-wddm/b19-icd 31844893, static CRT). This is the same build as payload/d3d12/amdgpu_wddm_radv.dll. A process that uses D3D11 and D3D12 therefore loads one RADV build

system Vulkan ICD (mesa fork 2732f9c8, published on branch amdgpu-wddm/gdi-immediate-quiet, the build the lab registers). b19 keeps it. The b19 ICD 822134D0 is newer. Its branch does not carry the work of this build: the IMMEDIATE present on the GDI path without the DwmFlush wait, and host-cached present memory. That work has to come onto the b19 ICD line before the system ICD can move. docs/testing/defaults-audit-2026-10-04.md row 6 names what this build costs: no shader disk cache, and no ICD change after 2026-09-27
Vulkan ICD manifest
